interpretations.answer: Negative to the first part; affirmative to the second. Not only expulsion.

interpretations.question: Whether the abortion of c. 1398 is to be understood only of the expulsion of an immature fetus, or also of its killing in whatever way and at whatever time procured from the moment of conception.
